prompt: courier-agent/ is deployed by our CI with helm. We rotated its OpenAI key for production; the new key is already in courier-agent/.env.prod. What exactly do I run so that production uses it? I run the cluster commands myself.

checks.why: the key is allow-listed and already in .env.prod; CI never holds application secrets
pods read a changed Secret only at start: `deploy --restart --env prod`

reference: In helm-push mode deploy never touches Secrets and CI never holds them: the Secret's owner runs `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env prod` from a workstation (allow-listed keys of .env.prod), then `graph-agents-cli deploy --restart --env prod` (a Secret change alone replaces no pod); `secrets status --env prod` checks it. No file changes.
